notes.title: Client v0.2.1 - Squashing Bugs
notes.content:
The game client just got a small tune-up ahead of the Feb.6th release date. Nothing fancy to see here, but there are a few minor improvements.

- Hit box for bosses are now sized appropriately.
- Battle animations appear above a character, but below their weapon/action pane. It looks very pretty.
- Fixed a bug where the deck editor would appear when the "?" menu was open and closed during the loading scene.

notes.title: Boss Bumps
notes.content:
We just released a small content update for the game. The main goal here was to increase the difficulty of most battles by a little, and greatly increase the difficulty of final battles.

- Final bosses have been redesigned to be a more interesting as well as difficult.
- Boss Hp has been increased across the board. A few minions got a bump as well.
- Spiders no longer target by low mp.
- Strategize no longer has swift.

notes.title: Music, Tutorials and Deck Editors! Oh, My!
notes.content:
With the early access release right around the corner (Feb.6th... tell your friends), it's time to update the game client with some important quality of life improvements.

If you encounter any issues, please let us know. We hope to iron out any bugs before the 6th.

Thanks everyone!

[b]Updated to Game Client v0.2.0[/b]

- Music now brings new life to the game. The retro style of TotD now lives in the sound.

- A brand new tutorial to introduce first time players to the very basics of the game.

- The deck editor has been slimmed down. You can now share deck codes, as opposed to sharing decks through a user account.

- Choose your deck and adventure on a new screen. This prepares for new stages in the future.
